| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |

| `cohort.reading_project` | `15` | Lo 2018 Methods: central readers; Project 15 reproduces the 877 baseline right-knee SOA exclusion exactly |  |

| `jsw.middle` | `keep` (choices: keep, exclude) | FNIH progressors lose at least 0.7 mm; the continuous change stays alongside | keep: knees losing between 0.5 and 0.7 mm stay in the sample as non-progressors; exclude: they are dropped (jsw.nonprogressor_mm is the upper bound of the excluded band, FNIH-style contrast) |
| `jsw.nonprogressor_mm` | `0.5` | FNIH contrast: non-progressors lose less than 0.5 mm; used when jsw.middle = exclude |  |
| `model.corstr` | `exchangeable` (choices: exchangeable, independence) | Two knees per person: logistic GEE with an exchangeable working correlation, as in analyses/crepitus_activity B3 |  |
| `outcomes.arthroplasty_timing` | `by_visit_days` (choices: by_visit_days) | A replacement counts from the first outcome visit whose V##VISDYS is on or after the replacement day |  |
| `outcomes.missing_visit_days` | `nominal_month` (choices: nominal_month) | When a participant has no V##VISDYS for an outcome visit, the replacement-timing check uses the visit's nominal month (config/oai.toml [visits]) in days |  |
| `outcomes.pain_baseline_item` | `P01KP{side}12CV` | Lo 2018 Methods quote the 12-month frequent-pain question; screening-visit item, as in analyses/lo2022_walking |  |
| `outcomes.pain_followup_item` | `V{visit}KP{side}12CV` | Lo 2018 Methods: symptoms at 12, 24, 36, 48 months; AllClinical follow-up item |  |
| `outcomes.roa_replacement` | `event` (choices: event, ignore) | Value names as in analyses/luyten_early_oa: a knee replacement is a radiographic OA event | event: a replaced knee counts as having ROA (and SOA) from its replacement; ignore: replacement does not make a knee a case |
| `outcomes.roa_source` | `outcomes99` (choices: readings, outcomes99) | kXR_SQ_BU_Descrip.pdf sections 1.3 and Appendix B recommend the OUTCOMES99 summary variables (V99E?XIOA) over merging reading projects by hand | Earliest visit with KL >= 2 from Projects 15, 37 and 43, carried forward; readings (Project 15, same visit) is refused past 48 months |
| `outcomes.roa_unread` | `unknown` (choices: unknown, no_roa) | OUTCOMES99 'no incidence' (V99E?XIOA = 2) holds only while the knee was read; V99E?XNOA gives the last visit with no ROA | unknown: after that visit (and between it and an incident visit) ROA is missing; no_roa: taken as absent (the first version of this analysis) |
| `progression.jsn_rule` | `whole_grade` (choices: whole_grade, within_grade) | oai.derive.knee_outcomes.progression: JSN (medial JSM and lateral JSL grades, which can carry half grades) progresses when a follow-up grade reaches the next whole grade | whole_grade: floor(follow-up) >= floor(base) + 1; within_grade: any rise over the base grade, half grades included |
| `progression.replacement_as_kl4` | `true` | KL 4 knees can only progress by replacement (spec, progression sample): a replacement counts as progression to KL 4 | True counts a replaced knee as progressed; false leaves replacement as its own outcome |

| `reverse.coding` | `any` (choices: any, count) | Direction B: incident or progressing OA between 48 and 96 months predicts steps at 72 months | any: a knee with an event in either knee marks the person (0/1); count: the number of affected knees (0/1/2) |
| `reverse.r2_kl_read` | `false` | R2 (steps at 72 months after worsening) uses OUTCOMES99 incidence and replacement; KL worsening needs the follow-up reading, available only for read knees (spec decision 6) | false: R2 omits KL worsening; true: adds it, restricted to the read knees |
| `sample.exclude_baseline_pain` | `false` | Spec sensitivity variant exclude_baseline_pain (P1 and S1): frequent knee pain can precede ROA on the X-ray, so low steps could follow a knee already on its way to ROA. SOA's definition already includes the pain component, so the guard targets incident ROA only | false keeps every knee at risk of ROA; true drops knees with frequent knee pain, or unknown frequent pain, at 48 months (sx known False at V06 required) from incident ROA: P1, S1 and the by-horizon companion. Knee replacement (S2) and incident SOA are unchanged |
| `sample.min_step_days` | `4` (choices: 1, 4) | Mirrors device.min_valid_days: a person counts when at least this many of their first valid days have complete steps | Keeps the per-person shares on the same footing as the release's valid-person rule. |
| `steps.bands` | `[5000, 7500, 10000]` | Steps/day cut points for band descriptives and tables (conventional 5,000, 7,500 and 10,000 steps/day) |  |
| `steps.spline_knots` | `[0.1, 0.5, 0.9]` | Natural-spline knots at the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles of steps/day (Harrell's three-knot placement) |  |
| `steps.transform` | `none` (choices: none, log) | Odds ratios per 1,000 steps/day; log(x + 1) as a variant gives ORs per log unit |  |
| `tkr.censor` | `last_visit` (choices: last_visit) | Replacement follow-up runs longer than the X-ray readings (OUTCOMES99 V99E?KDAYS); knees without replacement are censored at the last visit |  |
| `tkr.min_events` | `20` | Knee replacement models are fitted only with at least this many events; fewer are reported descriptively |  |

## Open (8)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `horizon.selection` | `known_or_case` (choices: known_or_case, complete) | Spec decision 5, as in analyses/crepitus_soa_longterm: keeps knees whose outcome at the horizon is known or that became cases earlier (applies to the by_horizon model) | known_or_case keeps cases who left and drops non-cases who left (favours cases); complete keeps only knees with a known outcome at the horizon |
| `outcomes.arthroplasty_scope` | `right` (choices: right, either) | Lo 2018 Methods: 'Any participant with a knee arthroplasty was identified as having Sx, ROA, and SOA' | 'Any participant' could mean a replacement in either knee |
| `outcomes.replacement_counts` | `adjudicated_or_self_report` (choices: adjudicated_or_self_report) | oai.derive.knee.REPLACEMENT_STATUS_COUNTS (from Lo 2022 p.1661): V99E*RPCF of 1 (self-reported) or 3 (adjudicated, confirmed), or RPSN = 1 (seen on a follow-up X-ray). Lo 2018 says only 'any participant with a knee arthroplasty' | A counted replacement with no day count (V99E*DAYS blank) never becomes SOA at a follow-up visit |
| `outcomes.roa_definition` | `kl2` (choices: kl2, kl2_jsn) | OUTCOMES99 offers incident KL >= 2 (V99E?XIOA) and incident KL >= 2 with JSN (V99E?XIOAN); Lo 2018 used KL >= 2 |  |
| `outcomes.roa_rule` | `same_visit` (choices: same_visit, ever) | Lo 2018 Methods: ROA = tibiofemoral KL >= 2; whether ROA is carried forward once seen is not stated |  |
| `outcomes.soa_missing` | `both_required` (choices: both_required, known_false) | Lo 2018 does not say whether SOA is missing or known absent when one component (pain or KL) is missing | known_false: no frequent pain (or KL < 2) rules SOA out even if the other component is missing |
| `progression.risk_kl` | `2-3` (choices: 2-3, 1-3) | Same entry as analyses/crepitus [progression.risk_kl]; no consensus, docs/reference/oai-progression-definition-crosswalk.md section 1 | KL progression needs a baseline grade that can still worsen (KL 4 cannot, except by replacement) and, for most definitions, existing radiographic OA. '1-3' also admits doubtful OA (KL 1). |
| `readings.followup_project` | `latest` (choices: latest, p37) | Follow-up films (72 and 96 months) were read in Project 37 (some by Project 42); which project's grade counts is not fixed by the release | latest: Project 43 where it read the film, else Project 37 (the module's FOLLOWUP_PROJECTS); p37: Project 37 only |

## Variants

| Variant | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `anchor_p15` | `readings.anchor_project = p15` | 48-month anchor grade from Project 15 only |
| `by_horizon` | `incidence.model = by_horizon` | Companion logistic 'outcome by V10' model in place of discrete-time |
| `exclude_baseline_pain` | `sample.exclude_baseline_pain = true` | Drop knees with frequent knee pain, or unknown frequent pain, at 48 months from incident ROA (P1, S1 and the by-horizon companion) |
| `followup_p37` | `readings.followup_project = p37` | Follow-up grades from Project 37 only |
| `horizon_120` | `periods.horizon = 12` | Follow-up to 120 months (V12; depends on Project 43) |
| `jsn_within_grade` | `progression.jsn_rule = within_grade` | JSN progression includes within-grade changes |
| `jsw_fnih_middle` | `jsw.middle = exclude` | Drop knees losing 0.5 to 0.7 mm (FNIH contrast) |
| `log_steps` | `steps.transform = log` | Steps enter as log(x + 1) |
| `progression_kl_1_to_3` | `progression.risk_kl = 1-3` | Progression risk set is KL 1-3 at 48 months |
| `r2_kl_worsening_read` | `reverse.r2_kl_read = true` | R2 also counts KL worsening in the read knees |
| `reverse_count` | `reverse.coding = count` | Reverse direction coded as the number of affected knees (0/1/2) |
| `roa_kl2_jsn` | `outcomes.roa_definition = kl2_jsn` | ROA = incident KL >= 2 with JSN (V99E?XIOAN) |
